title: The Healer's Companion Beyond the Courses
summary: A companion for healers past the courses that adds the long unbroken repair of a grievous wound and the rallying of the worn.

title: A Treatise on Restoring the Fallen
summary: A treatise on recalling a person from the edge of death within the short window before the pulse is lost for good.

title: The Healing Beyond the Body
summary: Teaches how qi spread round the body as a living field mends many wounds at once and eases all who stand in it.

title: The Cleansing Canon of Deep Taint
summary: A canon on lifting deep taint and curse and the backlash of a failed breakthrough out of the body and meridians.

title: The Twin-Hand Mending Treatise
summary: A treatise on healing with both hands in step so that each hand mends what the other cannot reach.

title: Manual of the Hawk's Watchful Healing
summary: A manual of healing by sharp sight that finds the hidden fault in a body and mends it from a distance.

title: The Basin and River Restoration
summary: A text on gathering healing qi like water in a basin and loosing it as a river that carries the dying back.

title: The Wind-Sworn Healer's Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of the wind-sworn healer who treats the wounded where they fall and clears the air of taint.

title: Manual of the Open Sky Mender
summary: A manual of the open-handed mender who hides no art and calls the failing back with breath and qi.

title: The Oath of the Tireless Hand
summary: A manual of the oath to tend the wounded until the last breath and of the long restoring work that oath demands.
